primaryChecks.text: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Wasn’t he most honorable of the three? Therefore he was made their captain. However he wasn’t included as one of the three.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He killed a huge Egyptian, and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
